name: Duan Xianchong
source:
Occupation: Law School freshman

Talent: Basic logical thinking.
Personality: Honest and responsible. Sometimes too egocentric, ignoring other people's ideas.
Dream: He aspires to be an honest and upright prosecutor, but his progress has been stalling because of discrepancies between dreams and reality.
Experience: He is in a relationship with Jiang Chengxue.
